Now we need to write LAMMPS input script. We'll create a file "in.silicon". Steps:

units metal
atom_style full
boundary p p p
read_data silicon.data
replicate 3 3 3

pair_style sw
pair_coeff * * /potentials/SW/Si.sw Si

neighbor 2.0 bin
neigh_modify delay 0 every 1 check yes

thermo 1000
thermo_style custom step temp press density

# define groups
variable t_target equal 2500
variable t_start equal 300
variable rate equal 2.2 # K per ps
# heating time in ps = (t_target - t_start)/rate = 1000 ps
variable t_heating equal (${t_target}-${t_start})/${rate}
# choose timestep 0.001 ps (1 fs)
timestep 0.001

# NPT heating
fix 1 all npt temp ${t_start} ${t_target} 0.1 iso 0 0 1.0

run ${t_heating}000 # convert ps to steps: 1000 ps / 0.001 = 1,000,000 steps

# unfix heating
unfix 1

# Equilibration at 2500K for 500 ps
fix 2 all npt temp ${t_target} ${t_target} 0.1 iso 0 0 1.0

# compute msd
compute myMSD all msd com yes

# output msd to file
fix 3 all ave/time 100 10 1000 c_myMSD[4] file msd.dat mode vector

run 500000 # 500 ps steps (0.001 ps per step)

unfix 2
unfix 3
